subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor and own this as a bundled Claude harness with an approved bridge package, or require the capability to ship as an external plugin instead?
rationale: The branch adds a provider-specific runtime, credentials/subprocess boundary, persistent session behavior, config surface, and a third-party executable dependency; choosing the permanent ownership boundary is not a mechanical review decision.

options.title: Externalize the harness
options.body: Require a standalone Claude plugin/package using public SDK seams and remove the bundled/core-specific coupling unless a missing generic API is demonstrated.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled implementation
options.body: Accept the product direction, assign package/security ownership, and require a narrowed redesign that removes the dependency bypass, sidecars, and cross-plugin internals before merge.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Keep the paired discussion open but do not continue reviewing this broad branch until maintainers select the supported Claude integration strategy.

recommendation.title: Externalize the harness
recommendation.body: Require a standalone Claude plugin/package using public SDK seams and remove the bundled/core-specific coupling unless a missing generic API is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: They have carried the implementation and the paired architecture discussion, so they are the best available routing contact while a repository decision owner is identified.
